## Checks

- [ ] `python -m autosci verify <card-id>` passes for every card touched
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] `python -m autosci selftest` catches every corruption
- [ ] `python -m autosci guard --base origin/main` is clean, or every listed change to the frozen core is intended and reviewed
- [ ] `python -m autosci lint <card-id> --strict` passes for every card touched
- [ ] reports were generated by `python -m autosci report`, not edited by hand
- [ ] no personal information in files or history
